rmrg_cr02h.why: The R slot's opcode and merge_en from RCU's interface flop on the issue channel (DA's ruling on RI-11: a flop at every block boundary, in the wrapper), wire only; fanout inside the block is check-ngd's. Decoded here by rcu_dec_pkg, the model's op-class decode (RI-21 (4)), to R2 and RW busy, which RA rev 81 times inside the module once it takes the opcode.
